attributes.name: Arkrhyst
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, each character at this location attempts a Dexterity or Acrobatics 12 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 1 Cold damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4 Cold damage.

If Arkhryst escapes, return him to the location where you encountered him.

"Tread not upon the frozen stones, lest Freezemaw see and steal your bones."—Tamiir-Quah Shoanti warning
